1. Section through the ring on the blender axis, looking north. True scale 1:20; heights from CAD and equipment.json.
2. Bins B01-B09 per dosing-plan.md; B10-B12 blanked. Only one feeder runs at a time (DosingStation.st).
3. The hopper floats on 3 cells: only the silicone sleeves touch it. Check free float before calibration.
4. Hand adds and premix are tipped into the P1-224 intake grate at 550 [21.7] after the bin charge.
5. Blender built in house (P1-301-GA): no riser stand; a drum on its dolly rolls in from the free end between the legs (664 clear).
6. Bond bins, feeders, hopper, screw, blender and sifter to ground (< 10 ohm). Lock out before opening (1910.147).
